name: Burning Strikes
notes: Applied to allies who attack a Seared target. 4.5s → ceil(4.5/5) = 1 turn. +10/20/30/40% attack speed (level-1 = 10%) + 10% move speed. In card game: attack_speed_bonus translates to +1 bonus attack this turn (threshold mechanic — at 100% bonus = extra attack). 10% bonus at level 1 is minor. attack_speed_bonus is extension field.
